title: L¹(ν) approximation of a unit-bounded integrable covector field by continuous compactly supported unit-bounded fields
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let ν be a finite Borel measure on ℝ^P, let β : ℝ^P → Covector (Euclid P) n be ν-integrable with covectorEuclideanNorm (β x) ≤ 1 for ν-a.e. x, and let δ > 0. Then there is a continuous, compactly supported g : ℝ^P → Covector (Euclid P) n with covectorEuclideanNorm (g x) ≤ 1 for every x and ∫⁻ ofReal(covectorEuclideanNorm (g x − β x)) dν(x) < ofReal δ.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (ν : Measure (Euclid P)) (β : Euclid P → Covector (Euclid P) n), IsFiniteMeasure ν → Integrable β ν → (∀ᵐ x ∂ν, covectorEuclideanNorm (β x) ≤ 1) → ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ g : Euclid P → Covector (Euclid P) n, Continuous g ∧ HasCompactSupport g ∧ (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm (g x) ≤ 1) ∧ ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (covectorEuclideanNorm (g x - β x)) ∂ν < ENNReal.ofReal δ
